scope: Two immutable independent ZIP/XML sources and eight actual native range copies, with pictures, shapes, absolute boxes and three basic charts. Complete and partial direct input vectors are observed separately. Excel/WPS runtime unverified.
producerDifferences: Calc redirects a complete copied direct chart vector, but keeps the whole original vector when only some or none of its cells are copied; these are observations, not an Excel runtime claim.
Calc normalizes native anchor containers, transformed frames, marker offsets and drawing names. SDK copies retain source kinds/flags, measured extents and inert rich source with fresh identities.

SDK keeps symbolic defined-name and structured-reference bindings rather than guessing rewritten definitions; this probe covers direct native vectors, not producer verification of every symbolic-reference copy.

Absolute SDK boxes require complete measured footprint coverage; cell-anchored objects follow their logical start marker. Original source markers and the producer's normalized geometry remain separate.
